_comment: Reference template only — not rendered as-is. Copy blocks into a fresh <work_dir>/prospecting-brief-spec.json, fill every [bracket], then render with scripts/render_dossier_pydocx.py exactly like the standard dossier-spec.json. See SKILL.md 'Prospecting brief variant' for when to use this vs. the standard dossier / exec one-pager. No deep web research for this variant — pull why_now/cohort/intent_topics from master-list.csv plus one light company-overview lookup only. Origin: a prospecting-brief-spec.json under content/<active>/accounts/<account-slug>/.

brand.bg: [resolved bg hex from the brand kit (`gtm_core.brandkit --key palette.canvas`)]

closingLine: Internal prospecting brief — not for customer distribution.

blocks.subline: Tier A · [cohort, e.g. FS Capital Markets & Lending] · no meeting booked yet
blocks.meta: [Month DD, YYYY]  ·  auto-generated from ICP scoring — 1-page cold brief

blocks.text: [2-3 sentences: what the company does, their market, and their scale — from master-list.csv's company/industry fields plus one light overview lookup if that's not already obvious.]

lines: [The specific ICP cohort + why-now/intent signal that scored this account Tier A — pulled from master-list.csv's why_now/cohort/intent_topics fields. State it as the concrete reason this lead is worth a rep's time right now, not a generic 'good ICP fit' claim.]

rows: [Inferred pain point, given their business + cohort — mark clearly as inferred, not confirmed.]
[Inferred pain point #3, optional — omit the row if only two are genuinely plausible.]

blocks.text: [One short, concrete paragraph connecting the likely needs above to what the lead product actually does — grounded in profiles/<active>/knowledge/product.md. Tag any capability SHIPPED/CONDITIONAL/ROADMAP per docs/product-accuracy.md; never state a conditional/roadmap capability as live.]

lines: [Recommended next step — the specific angle to open with, or the call to book. One line, not a hard sell — an internal prep note for the rep.]
